_comment: RE Admin API — Postman Collection. Import this file into Postman via File > Import. Run POST /record first so agentId is captured automatically for all ID-based requests.

info.name: Module 7 — RE Admin API
info.description: All endpoints for the RE Admin MERN application. Base URL: http://localhost:5050. Make sure the backend server is running before sending any requests.

_comment_variables: Collection variables are shared across all requests. Update userEmail and userPassword to match the user you inserted in MongoDB Atlas. agentId is set automatically after POST /record runs.

variable._comment: Base URL of the Express backend. Change this if the server runs on a different port.
Automatically populated by the POST /record test script. No need to set this manually.
Update this to match the email of the user document you inserted in MongoDB Atlas.
Update this to match the password of the user document you inserted in MongoDB Atlas.

item._comment: Authentication folder — contains the login endpoint and two failure scenarios.
item.name: Authentication
item.description: POST /users/login validates email and password against the users MongoDB database. Returns 200 on success, 401 on failure.

item._comment: Happy path — correct credentials. Expects 200 and a success message.
item.name: POST /users/login — Success

request.description: Logs in with valid credentials using the userEmail and userPassword collection variables. Expected response: 200 with { message: 'Login successful' }.

item._comment: Failure scenario 1 — email does not exist in the users collection. Expects 401.
item.name: POST /users/login — Wrong Email

request.description: Attempts login with an email that does not exist in the database. Expected response: 401 Unauthorized: email not found.

item._comment: Failure scenario 2 — email exists but password is wrong. Expects 401.
item.name: POST /users/login — Wrong Password

request.description: Attempts login with a correct email but incorrect password. Expected response: 401 Unauthorized: incorrect password.

item._comment: Agents folder — full CRUD. Run POST /record first. The test script captures the insertedId and stores it in {{agentId}} automatically.
item.name: Agents
item.description: Full CRUD operations for agent records. Run POST /record — Create Agent first. The agentId variable is set automatically so GET by ID, PATCH, and DELETE require no manual setup.

item._comment: CREATE — inserts a new agent into MongoDB. The test script below automatically saves the insertedId to the agentId collection variable.
item.name: POST /record — Create Agent

event._comment: This script runs after the response is received. It extracts the insertedId from the response and saves it as the agentId collection variable so all other ID-based requests work automatically.

exec: // Parse the response body as JSON.
// If the insert was successful, MongoDB returns an insertedId.
// Save it as a collection variable so GET, PATCH, and DELETE can use it.

request.description: Creates a new agent. Do not include sales — the backend sets it to 0 automatically. After this request, agentId is set automatically for all subsequent requests.

item._comment: READ ALL — returns every agent document in the agents collection.
item.name: GET /record — Get All Agents

request.description: Returns all agent documents from the agents database. Returns an empty array if no agents exist yet.

item._comment: READ ONE — returns a single agent using the agentId variable set by POST /record.
item.name: GET /record/:id — Get Agent by ID

request.description: Returns a single agent by MongoDB _id. Uses {{agentId}} which is set automatically after running POST /record.

item._comment: UPDATE — modifies an existing agent using the agentId variable. Note: sales is excluded intentionally.
item.name: PATCH /record/:id — Update Agent

request.description: Updates an existing agent by MongoDB _id. Uses {{agentId}} set automatically after POST /record. The sales field cannot be updated through this endpoint — it is excluded by the backend schema.

item._comment: DELETE — permanently removes an agent using the agentId variable. Cannot be undone.
item.name: DELETE /record/:id — Delete Agent

request.description: Permanently deletes an agent by MongoDB _id. Uses {{agentId}} set automatically after POST /record. This action cannot be undone.
